text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I became
Sasami
Anshinzawa's acupuncture test
dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After heading out with her, I would train
to
become more Umamusume-like and
receive
acupuncture treatment. One
such day...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good, good! ♪ Your body's shaping up
just the
way I like! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now you should be able to participate
on that
legendary stage that everyone
dreams of—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: The Needle Series!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: What?! You've never heard of it?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The Needle Series is the highlight of the

acupuncture world, where

acupuncture-augmented humans are
pitted
against each other in races!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! ♪ We're an unstoppable duo
together,
with you as the runner and me
as the trainer! Our
victory is practically
guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Why, what's this? You don't seem all
that
excited!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen, once you experience running in a
race
yourself, you'll be able to apply
what you learn in
your trainee's training
sessions!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Watching a race and running one are
two
completely different things! Haven't
you realized
this from your training up
till now? You must
have!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want <chrname>
to
improve? Don't you want to help her
achieve her
dreams?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, you have no choice but to
enter this
competition! Then you'll have
no worries in the
world! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! All right, it's decided!
Now that
that's finalized, let's go get
you signed up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If you manage to win it all, people will
come to
recognize my skills too, so it'll
be two birds with one
stone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how my partnership with
Sasami
Anshinzawa begins!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, our goal is to dominate the
Needle
Series, and to do that, we'll have
to win the
Sasabari Sho! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you can't enter it right
away—you'll
need to accumulate plenty
of racing experience
to qualify!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's set our sights on winning
the
Bamboo Stakes! ♪ Aaand to do
that...
choice_data_list: い、意外とちゃんとしている……

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're going to have to undergo more
advanced
training. ♪ I'd say we'll need
to ramp training up
to level five!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Do a volleyball dive!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Next up, some rapid doggy paddling!
Wow,
you're crazy fast! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Karate chop that tile! Yaaah! No worries!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No worries! No worries! Good, keep
pulling that
tire in time with the
chant! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, you will face me in shogi! Do you
have
what it takes to—no way, did you
just put me in
check already?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, great job toda—whoa! You're
looking pretty
burnt-out!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Don't worry, you can count on
your dear
trainer to provide an extra
special treatment as a
reward for your
hard work! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: To the infirmary! Let's go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, this is the Rest in Peace chakra,
and when I
poke it, all your fatigue will
be washed away! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh come on, don't be like that! The texts I read definitely described it that way!
choice_data_list: 名前があんし～ん出来ないんですが……

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Enough chitchat! Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I come to my senses, I find myself
standing
in an unfamiliar place. The last
thing I remember,
I was receiving
acupuncture treatment, but...
Trainer... Trainer, canst thou hear me?

I am the god of acupuncture... Ye who
seeketh
the zenith of the Needle Series,
I hereby bestow
upon thee mine
blessings...

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text:
O Trainer, dost thou desireth the power
to attain
glory?

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text:
Nay, thou needn't answer, for I know
thou cravest
it so. Very well, allow me to
fulfill thy desire!

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text: Annnd poketh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An almighty feeling flows throughout my
body. So
this is the power bestowed by
the gods!

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Whilst thou art at it, please
look after
that fool of an acupuncturist
as well...
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます、神様！

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally awake. I bet you feel
nice and
refreshed, don't you? Looks
like it was a great
success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever that was, my body is feeling
better
than ever. All traces of my fatigue
seem to have
vanished.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I knew it all along—acupuncture is the
solution to
everything! ♪ No worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So this is the power bestowed by the
gods? It's
not quite as miraculous as I
thought it'd be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I feel as though my vitality is
being
steadily drained from my body!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wha—? That's strange... There's no way
that I,
divine acupuncturist as I am,
would ever slip up
during treatment!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Eh, whatever! Thank you for your
patronage, and
come again! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally awake. You were
tossing and
turning in your sleep a lot.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Anyways, I'm heading on home! See you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I missed that chakra point by a
millimeter, but
that probably didn't
cause any lasting issues,
right?! Nah,
definitely not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know whether to blame the
botched
acupuncture or the weird
dream, but either way...
My fatigue
doesn't improve in the slightest.
